caption:
I asked my team a question that left everyone silent for two minutes: "What are you obsessed with?"

At first, nobody had an answer. So I went first, and then the answers started coming. Adventure. Coding. Things people could talk about endlessly.

I borrowed the question from the founder of Wispr Flow, who uses it in his hiring process. It made me rethink how we look at people when we hire.

Being good at something makes you capable of doing it. Being obsessed with it makes you want to keep getting better at it.

So: if I asked your team what they're obsessed with, would they have an answer? Would you know yours?

Tell me yours in the comments.

#hiring #teamculture #founderstory #startupindia #leadership #creativeupaay
